title: "Maintenance and Calibration"
---

## Maintenance and Cleaning

Before each patient use, wipe the device body and camera tip with a soft cloth dampened with an approved medical-grade disinfectant (e.g., 70% isopropyl alcohol).

Do not submerge the device in liquid.

Ensure the camera lens is clean and free of smudges for optimal image quality.

---

## Calibration

Image calibration targets are included with the cradle. Users capture images of these targets through automated procedures to assess the performance of the camera and light source. These images are uploaded and stored as references, enabling ongoing monitoring of system quality control over time. An example target is shown here, with additional examples and detailed explanations available in the Calibration Guide.
